title: Royal Palm Casita
description: Your tropical escape in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico - minutes from world famous surf breaks and completely immersed in nature. This charming solar-powered A-frame casita tucked beneath a canopy of royal palms sits beside a gentle stream, offering a serene, off-grid experience surrounded by lush greenery and the sounds of the coqui.Thoughtfully designed, completely detached - those chasing waves or simply looking to unplug will experience a perfect mix of rustic comfort and natural beauty.The spaceWell planned tiny house A-frame. Queen bed in loft and full indoor bathroom with ample naturalized outdoor spaces, concrete patios and a bonus outdoor tub for added ambiance. Fold down futon.Please note: The property operates exclusively on solar power and has municipal water supply. Power is reliable unless we have several days consecutive cloudy weather. Brief water outages are possible (a common quirk of island life!). Solar power is adequate to run AC mini-split at will, but we ask that you not run AC when the casita is unoccupied. WiFi is moderate strength and indoors only. Cell service is unlikely unless set for WiFi assist and you are inside.While limitations of an off-grid experience apply, Royal Palm Casita is only a 2 minute drive to the bustling Pueblo to capture better signal when necessary and 5 minutes to Rincon best beaches which is what matters most!Guest accessGuests have access to a parking spaces at top of hill, patios surrounding the casita, the casita, and the natural environment co-located next to and behind the house.Other things to noteParking is at the top of staircase, there are 48 shallow steps to the entry. This property is not suitable for guests with mobility limitations.5 minutes or less drive to 5 unique beaches and Rincon’s world famous surf breaks.Just a heads up-as you can see in the photos since we're in a jungle setting, you might come across some bugs and insects around the area. It's all part of the natural experience here, but we do our best to keep things as comfortable as possible by having a professional pest control service that treats the property monthly. iguanas, lizards, turtles & ants are common in this naturalized settings. iguanas are afraid of you, so just keep a distance.Visit Art Walk Thursday evenings in the Rincón plaza (local artists, diverse restaurants, live music, Rincon Beer Company for island brews). The Rincón lighthouse is a favorite local spot for beautiful sunsets overlooking Domes beach and surf break. Feel like exploring? Cabo Rojo, La Parguera, San Sebastián waterfalls, and Arecibo caves are optional day trips.If there is any uncertainty in your travel plan, consider purchasing CFAR (cancel for any reason) trip insurance at checkout or independently.

title: Penthouse Apartment I and Ocaso Luxury Villa
description: Escape to the mountains! This hidden gem one bedroom penthouse apartment accommodates from two to four adults. Enjoy your private glass terrace overlooking incredible views and the pool.
